approach: The PS2 executable (SLUS-21627) statically recompiled to C++ with PS2Recomp on the Urban Reign PC port's runtime: the game's IRX modules interpreted, VU1 compiled ahead of time, PCSX2's GS as a library (Vulkan on Linux). Linux first, brought up bottom up one hardware layer at a time, each checked against PCSX2; a native renderer later.
notes: Recon done: single stripped Metrowerks ELF, no overlays; Sidhe's Mab engine, Lua 5.0.2, ODE physics, FMOD audio, .pss movies. Repo shaped like Vnnc1/gow-native-pc (game profile, pinned runtime, numbered patches). Next: first runtime build, then the Ghidra function map. No game data included: bring your own PS2 copy.
